text: GALPD[mu,n,nb] denotes the positive component in the lightcone decomposition of the Dirac matrix \gamma^{\mu } along the vectors n and nb in D-dimensions. It corresponds to \frac{1}{2} \bar{n}^{\mu} (\gamma \cdot n).
Overview, DiracGamma, GALND, GALRD, GSLPD, GSLND, GSLRD.
